_id.description: The unique identifier for a book.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the book record was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the book record was last updated.

fileId.description: The identifier for the file associated with the book.

year.description: The year the book was published.

genre.description: The genre or category of the book.

totalChars.description: The total number of characters in the book.

totalChunks.description: The total number of chunks the book is divided into.

finished.description: Indicates whether the book processing is finished.

source.description: The source of the book, such as user upload or shop.

isPinned.description: Indicates whether the book is pinned by the user.
